rules.comment: No module of the public package may import an optional composition package at module level, inside a function, under TYPE_CHECKING, or through a literal dynamic import. Optional packages may import public code; public code must remain independently installable.

PLUGIN-01: the versioned plugin RPC authority is schema-only and may depend only on Pydantic, stdlib, and the existing pure WritePlan contract. Process, provider, project, and server/runtime imports belong to PLUGIN-02 or host adapters.

map_runner split: extracted leaf modules must never re-import the engine, or the split re-fuses. Wildcard over the runner package; only the package facade (__init__) is a legitimate map_runner importer.

project.py split: extracted store leaf modules must never re-import the Project facade, or the split re-fuses. Wildcard over the store package; the excludes are the facade itself plus the frozen set of pre-split stores that already take a typed Project (evidence, media_clip, artifact_timeline). New leaf modules get no exclusion — they receive the project duck-typed.

The frisket.preview family is read-only by contract (no receipts, no runs, no job queue, no project writes; see preview/__init__.py). The forbidden set is the receipted execution machinery: the action executor, the job queue, the run engine, the receipt store, and the whole frisket.engine.runner package. No exclude is needed: preview.cluster shares deterministic fingerprint-clustering helpers from the ops layer instead.

Layer rule: the execution core must not depend on the web/server or team layers. The exclude list is the frozen set of pre-existing edges (runner.review -> server.paging; executor export/source families -> server.exports/server.sources/server.notifications; jobs -> server.provider_config/server.notifications/server.sources/team.control_plane; store.credentials -> team.security). No new engine module may add such an import.

Layer rule: the execution core must not depend on the features layer. The exclude list is the frozen set of feature consumers, including entity_package (the admitted FollowTheMoney dataset/package adapter), typed mutation_action, file_fetch (the admitted adapter replacing the SDK fetch classifier), and visual_cuts_read/topic_sections_read (the admitted temporal adapters replacing SDK finder orchestration), executor temporal/url_classification/watchlists/geometry/topic_segmentation consumers; jobs watchlists; store url_classification/watchlists — the store edge now lives in store.watches after the project.py split. No unrelated engine module may add such an import. The store.bundle_migrations exception is gone with the migration layer: its only features import was the watch-spec metadata backfill.
Layer rule: op implementations must not depend on the web/server or team layers.
Workbench wire-version constants live in the pure workbench contract. Neither that owner nor the generic contracts package may depend on the plugin runtime helper that consumes them.

The contracts package is the pure wire/schema layer: request/response shapes, action descriptors, and endpoint policy/catalog. It may reference descriptor constants, but never the service/runtime layers that execute work.
The map-points service consumes whatever projection backend the plugin registry provides; it must never re-weld itself to a geo-branded module.
Media acquisition runs the installed yt-dlp dependency out of process (`python -I -m yt_dlp`). No plugin/transport module may re-grow an in-process `import yt_dlp`.
The sdk is the embeddable public surface. It composes executor/contracts/store/ops, but must not depend on the web server or the hosted control plane.
